verdict.tagline: Brutal learning curve and smooth physics make this the ultimate bike sim.
for_you_if: you want realistic physics and deep simulation
you are willing to learn through crashing
you enjoy setting up community mods and tracks
not_for_you_if: you are discouraged by a steep learning curve
you want a complete package without external mods
you run into map loading crashes
